thread:
Marta (partnerships): Heads-up — CipherMesh (new HSM vendor) wants a joint marketplace listing + co-announcement. We need SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, KMS/HSM key-wrap integration, and a secrets-manager connector. Target announce week: May 12. Who can join a quick sync? :eyes:
Sam G (product): I can. Need embargo date and PR owner. Also want a demo plan for the console listing.
Priya R (security): Quick checklist: HSM attestation, FIPS/CC certs, key-wrapping APIs, and SCIM provisioning scoped to groups. Do we have their attestation docs?
CipherMesh Rep: Hi team — we can share attestation PDF and PKCS#11 + KMIP endpoints. Timeline: integration readiness by May 3, QA week May 4-8, ready for joint announcement May 12.
Andre L (eng): For KMS integration, we need a sample wrap/unwrap flow. CipherMesh, can you confirm supported algorithms? e.g., RSA-OAEP-256 and AES-GCM keywrap?
CipherMesh Rep: Supported: RSA-OAEP-256, RSA-OAEP-1, and AES-KW. We also expose a REST wrapper for cloud customers: `https://kms.ciphermesh.example.com/v1/wrap`.
DevX (devex): We'll need a staging VM + test HSM creds for our demo and docs. Prefer a short-lived service account + SCIM sandbox for automated user provisioning.
Marta (partnerships): Good. Legal/marketing sync also needed — embargo and joint blog. @LegalBot can you confirm embargo window?
LegalBot: Hold: need signed joint-PR MOU + review of partner quotes. Recommend 48-hour embargo window post-asset signoff.
Sam G (product): Ok — product will own demo, marketing owns blog; partnerships will coordinate quotes and joint webinar. Action items: 1) Get attestation docs from CipherMesh (CipherMesh Rep), 2) provide staging creds (CipherMesh Rep), 3) SCIM mapping and sample payload (Andre/DevX), 4) legal MOU draft (LegalBot), 5) announce plan + webinar date (Marta/Sam).
Andre L (eng): SCIM example mapping we intend to use (rough):
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "user.email",
  "name": {"givenName": "first","familyName":"last"},
  "active": true,
  "groups": ["teams"]
}
```
Andre L (eng): Also for connector config sample: `secrets://redwood/v1/connectors/ciphermesh?kms_url=https://kms.ciphermesh.example.com&keywrap=RSA-OAEP-256`
Priya R (security): Also verifying: will keys be wrapped in HSM and never leave? Need to ensure KMS returns only wrapped key material. Please include a note in the MOU that unwrapped key export is not permitted.
CipherMesh Rep: Confirmed — BYO-key and wrapping only. We can provide attestation + an operator ACL for wrapped key-only policies.
DevX (devex): I created a calendar hold for the sync: Tue May 7 10:00am PT — 30m. calendar-bot: meeting scheduled.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: partnerships w/ CipherMesh — Tue May 7, 10:00am PT. Zoom link in calendar invite.
Marta (partnerships): Perfect. Last asks before the sync: CipherMesh please drop attestation and staging creds into the shared drive; LegalBot please send MOU template; DevX please prep SCIM test users and quick runbook for the demo. We'll run integration QA during the week of May 4.
Sam G (product): I'll draft the demo script (console + API flow) and share by Friday. :thumbsup:
Priya R (security): I'll review attestation and draft the security checklist.
CipherMesh Rep: Will upload docs and creds by EOD tomorrow. Looking forward to the sync.
Marta (partnerships): Great — see you all on the call. We'll convert action items into a shared checklist after the meeting. :white_check_mark:
